constraints: Candidates come from public first-party brand/menu pages or their directly referenced media hosts; upstream source captures were observed 2026-10-18.

A brand-level food image does not prove a particular outlet sells that item, nor that the image depicts the specific stall. Exact outlet attribution is retained only where source evidence includes matching SFA licence.
URL reachability/HTTP status is reported only when present in the source snapshot; this consolidation did not make extra image requests.
No assets were copied or downloaded. No image has been visually reviewed unless the cited source snapshot says otherwise.
No display, redistribution, or derivative-use rights were cleared; candidates remain review-only and should not populate approved display fields until rights are confirmed.
Menu photos are food/product images, not verified photographs of physical stalls. No genuine stall-photo candidates were found in this bounded collection.
